newsitem.title: EGYPT: Alliance Capital, CIIC planning Egyptian fund.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Capital, CIIC planning Egyptian fund.

text.p: Alliance Capital Management L.P. and Egypt's Commercial International Investment Company (CIIC) plan to set up a closed-end investment fund based in Luxembourg and specialising in Egyptian equities, New York-based Alliance Capital said in a statement published on Friday.

State-owned National Bank of Egypt (NBE) would be a minority shareholder in a joint-venture company to manage the fund and this company would be called Alliance Capital CIIC Investment Management Ltd, it said.
Alliance Capital would have a 60 percent stake, CIIC 30 percent and NBE 10 percent, it added. CIIC is affiliated with Egypt's Commercial International Bank (CIB).

The investment fund would be registered in Luxembourg and would invest mainly in privatised Egyptian companies. It could also invest small amounts in Egyptian government bonds which have not yet been listed on the Egyptian stock exchange.
The statement did not say how big the fund would be or when it might start inviting subscriptions.
